items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: We was the three brothers in the McRae Brothers Band at that time when we put this band together. It was Bill and Floyd --

ctx.x: Okay. Gunable also had you do some work on clarinet.
Yeah, he taught me. He had to -- see, he always said that you have to learn the clarinet because the clarinet will make you a much better saxophone player. Because clarinet was hard, you know.

And the clarinet was a very necessary instrument for any reed man. (inaudible). Eventually will have to learn the clarinet, so you might as well get on it at an early stage where you can take it along with you. With the saxophone, you know.
